title: Eight days through the mined Channel with refugees
summary: The ship took eight days to clear the Channel, carried refugees hiding gold, and passed U-boat convoys.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: We left that one Saturday night at 11 o'clock. It took us eight days to get through the English Channel, because it was heavily mined. Eight days to get out of the Channel.
You went to...?
We came on the Veian dam(?).
How did they take you through the Channel? Did they have to have ships to guide?
Yes.
Pilots.
One after the other, mostly the Navy. Eight days it took us to get through the Channel to avoid... Because I guess the mine fields were heavy.
That must have been a bit worrying.
Yes, you know it was! [LAUGHS] Wilson Myers
Ramirez - 68

and I, we shared a bunk together with the Three Dukes. And it was a riot. We had all kinds of... This thing about... I hear Americans turning or rebuffing, you know, ships and all that business. I can't see that, because most of the ships were carrying refugees. Very few Americans were on that boat. There were three Australians, and the rest of them were refugees from all of those countries, ...(?)... carrying instruments, laden with gold. People were getting an extra amount of gold in their teeth; you know, their dentures were all gold. It was an uncanny...you know, the way people were trying to get out, you know, out of the countries. Especially if you were Jewish, it was pretty hard in those days. I mean, to take a fellow(?) riding immersed in these car (?)s with a solid gold shift, you know...! [LAUGHS] And spokes on the wheels made of gold... I'd never seen anything...
You had cars on this ship?

They weren't allowed to bring any money out of the country. Anything... Especially if you were a refugee, you had to leave your country. And hubcaps, you know, and inside were gold... I saw a guy who had a cello. You know the cello stands?
Yes?
It was gold. Solid gold.
Ramirez - 69
But were they able to take their cars on the ship?
They confiscated the cars, but they'd take the ball.
Oh, I see. The gear shift.
Yeah. And put them in another ball, you know.
Once you got through the Channel, I take it you were able to go full speed ahead more or less.
You mean...
The ship, you know, once you got through the Channel.
Oh, we were open... You had to watch U-boats, you know. One time we saw a string of...like a city of Liberty ships all together, and there were two or three...what do you call those small...?
Destroyers?
Destroyers monitoring them. They were like sitting ducks up there. A whole city. We picked up a couple of survivors from a wreck...they were blown up.
